clippings.speaker: Gene Wilder
clippings.quote: I met Mel backstage in Anne's dressing room. He was wearing one of those pea coats, pea jackets that were made famous by the Merchant Marines. And I admired it, and he said, you know, they used to call this a urine jacket, but it didn't sell. And I laughed, and he laughed.
clippings.title: In This 2005 Interview, Gene Wilder Explains How He Learned To Get Laughs
clippings.context: Wilder to Terry Gross in 2005, rebroadcast after his death, on meeting Brooks while acting opposite Anne Bancroft.

clippings.speaker: Gene Wilder
clippings.quote: And then when I met him, there was a closeness because I loved that kind of humor, his kind of humor. It wasn't any part of my life, in my humor, but I just appreciated it. There was an affinity there somewhere. And in so many ways we're not at all alike, and in some ways we're very much alike.
clippings.title: In This 2005 Interview, Gene Wilder Explains How He Learned To Get Laughs
clippings.context: Wilder to Terry Gross in 2005 on admiring Brooks's writing for Your Show of Shows before they met.

clippings.speaker: Gene Wilder
clippings.quote: He said, are you crazy? This is frivolous. You're just being frivolous. Well, my temperature rose, and after 20 minutes or so of arguing, my color went from red to, I think, blue or purple. I was - started screaming and then all of a sudden, he said, OK, it's in. And I said, well, why did you put me through this? And he said, I wasn't sure if it was right.
clippings.title: In This 2005 Interview, Gene Wilder Explains How He Learned To Get Laughs
clippings.context: Wilder to Terry Gross in 2005 on their one fight, over the "Puttin' On The Ritz" number.

clippings.speaker: Mel Brooks
clippings.quote: I've been very close to Gene all our adult lives, and I knew. First of all, he was a brave guy.
clippings.title: Mel Brooks Salutes 'Magnificent' Gene Wilder, Spills Secrets of 'Young Frankenstein' — Including the Classic Scene That Was Almost Cut and the Upcoming Musical Reboot (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Brooks interviewed days after Wilder's death in August 2016.

clippings.speaker: Mel Brooks
clippings.quote: He was incredible in my first movie, The Producers. He had that blue blanket — hysterical. It was just amazing — nobody else in the world could have done that.
clippings.title: Mel Brooks Salutes 'Magnificent' Gene Wilder, Spills Secrets of 'Young Frankenstein' — Including the Classic Scene That Was Almost Cut and the Upcoming Musical Reboot (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Brooks naming his favorite Wilder performance.

clippings.speaker: Mel Brooks
clippings.quote: So we went back and argued, and I said, "Look, Gene Wilder insists!" I blamed it on Gene, but it was really me.
clippings.title: Mel Brooks Salutes 'Magnificent' Gene Wilder, Spills Secrets of 'Young Frankenstein' — Including the Classic Scene That Was Almost Cut and the Upcoming Musical Reboot (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Brooks on fighting Columbia to shoot Young Frankenstein in black and white.

clippings.speaker: Mel Brooks
clippings.quote: And I called Gene, and I said, you're absolutely right all the time, and I'm glad we're - it's in, totally.
clippings.title: A 'Fresh Air' Halloween treat: Revisiting 'Young Frankenstein'
clippings.context: Brooks to David Bianculli in 2013, rebroadcast in 2025, on conceding the "Puttin' On The Ritz" scene after seeing it cut in.
